subject: Implementation launch — availability matrix & agenda template
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@pinetree.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Tyler Morgan <tyler.morgan@evergreenretail.com>
Date: 2027-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Aligning on launch week availability and agenda requests

Hi Aditya —

Thanks again for the quick product walkthrough last week. PineTree is ready to move forward with the implementation window next month and we want to lock a 90-minute launch planning session with your team to align milestones, responsibilities, and calendar cadence.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can you share a short agenda (30–45 min sections) so we can invite the right stakeholders?
- We’ve attached an availability matrix for the core group; can you propose two 90-minute windows next week that work for your team?
- Any pre-reads or access (sandbox keys, sample data schema) we should prepare ahead of the meeting?

Attendees on our side: Alicia Gomez (onboarding lead), Tyler Morgan (product ops), Procurement (procurement@pinetree.com).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Onboarding Lead | PineTree Analytics
[Attachment: Availability_Matrix.csv (csv, 2KB)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@pinetree.com>, Tyler Morgan <tyler.morgan@evergreenretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-11T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning on launch week availability and agenda requests

Hi Alicia —

Appreciate the clear asks. I’ve pulled together a draft 90-minute agenda and populated a lightweight availability matrix for our recommended facilitators. I’m attaching both for review: Agenda_Template_v2.docx and an updated Availability_Matrix.csv (we merged PineTree’s slots into our schedule).

Proposed windows (PST):
- Option A: Tue 2027-08-17, 10:00–11:30
- Option B: Wed 2027-08-18, 13:00–14:30

Draft 90-minute agenda (high level):
1) 10 min — Introductions & success criteria (customer goals + internal RACI)
2) 20 min — Implementation milestones & timeline (milestones, hard dates)
3) 25 min — Data/access requirements and validation plan (sample schemas + sandbox access)
4) 15 min — Integration responsibilities & runbooks (who owns what)
5) 15 min — Next steps, follow-ups, and calendar cadence (weekly stand / async checkpoints)

Pre-reads we recommend: current sample data schema, an exported sample of 100 rows (sanitized), and any SSO/KMS constraints. If you can share the sample data schema ahead of the meeting we’ll confirm sandbox provisioning timelines during the session.

Please confirm which window works and we’ll route calendar invites with the appropriate meeting links (Zoom) and a Confluence page for the runbook.

Attachments: Agenda_Template_v2.docx (docx, 28KB), Availability_Matrix.csv (csv, 3KB)

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1-415-555-0192
